kangaroo-at-2024-01.prompt: Kangaroo Joey wants to jump through the maze. Joey starts in the square on the bottom left (see picture). The number of arrows decides how long the jump must be. choices.text: Joey cannot leave the maze anywhere.

It is impossible that exactly 2 cups are on the matching saucers.
